verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a way to 'Interact programmatically with GitLab' (API access) which implies SDK-style build capability, but the evidence pack never names specific official SDKs (e.g., Python/JS/Go client libraries) or documents their agentic/AI-native use cases explicitly. missing for 10: named official SDK packages/languages, documentation of AI-agent-specific SDK usage, independent developer corroboration of building against these SDKs.
